description: This file defines the 'Interview' entity class for the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, representing interview data including candidate, interview details, and interviewers with ORM mappings.

classes.name: Interview
classes.description: Entity class representing an interview, with ORM mappings, relationships to candidates, vacancy, interviewers, and associated properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the interview.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the interview.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Associates a CandidateVacancy entity with the interview.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Returns the Candidate entity related to this interview.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with this interview.

methods.name: getInterviewName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewName
methods.description: Sets the name of the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewDate
methods.description: Returns the scheduled date for the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewDate
methods.description: Sets the scheduled date for the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewTime
methods.description: Returns the scheduled time for the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewTime
methods.description: Sets the scheduled time for the interview.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves any notes associated with the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewers
methods.description: Returns the list of interviewers participating in this interview.
